title: SolidWizard sees AI, semiconductor orders through 2027
content: Rising investment in AI, semiconductors, and high-performance computing is driving demand for advanced software, giving 3D digital design and AI solutions provider SolidWizard Technology strong order visibility from AI and semiconductor customers through 2027. SolidWizard reported consolidated revenue of NT$1.328 billion (US$40.4 million) for the first three quarters of 2026, up 13.61% year-over-year.

title: Axiomtek restructures for physical AI, expands global customer reach
content: Industrial PC (IPC) maker Axiomtek sustained growth in Q3 2026, reporting quarterly revenue of NT$2.779 billion (US$84.6 million), up 11.5% quarter-over-quarter and 59.32% year-over-year, while its operating margin rose to 13.09%. The company attributed the growth to demand for edge computing, industrial IoT, and AI, as well as more key accounts shifting to direct engagement.
